name: ux-laws
description: Twenty named UX laws (Hick, Fitts, Jakob, Doherty, Gestalt grouping, progressive disclosure, feedback loops, and more) applied to one screen at a time. A user-invoked build mode designs and implements a view with the laws as decision rules and reports what changed; a read-only review mode reports at most five ranked findings with file:line evidence and fixes. Never commits.
